description: Run an owner command against the live app (changes are audited). Commands that cannot be undone or reach users (publish, prices, offers, deletes, API keys) do nothing and return { code: "needs_confirm", plan } first: show the plan to the owner, then ask the owner to approve the returned challenge in the admin (approval_url). You cannot approve it yourself, and confirm: true alone does nothing. Once approved, call again with the same args and approval: <challenge id>. An approval works once, for 10 minutes, for exactly those args.

approval.description: Challenge id the owner approved; pass the same args

name: owner_command
